text: Recent visitor reviews highlight several issues that need attention, particularly around parking, ticketing, and visitor flow. Many guests reported frustration with the limited availability of advance tickets and the lack of walk-up options, which led to some being turned away after traveling long distances. Parking was frequently described as poorly designed, with narrow lanes and insufficient camper spaces, and signage for traffic control was unclear. Some visitors also noted long lines at security and a lack of restroom facilities outside the entrance. While the architecture and interactive exhibits received positive mentions, concerns were raised about the heavy use of AI in the exhibits and the overall value compared to other presidential libraries.
